data.detail: The document is an amendment to a Master Services Agreement focusing solely on updating pricing terms for palletised freight. It contains no indemnity clauses or obligations of any kind, reciprocal or one-sided. Therefore, the policy rule regarding a one-sided indemnity obligation is not triggered.

request_preview:
Policy rule: Does this document contain an indemnity obligation that binds only one party, with no reciprocal obligation on the other? Answer triggered=true only if the one-sidedness is stated in the text you cite.
